annotations.title: SPF, DKIM and DMARC record lookup

description: Look up a domain's email authentication records and report what they say, with no grade: the SPF record (its terms, how it ends, and how many of the 10 allowed DNS lookups it uses), DKIM keys (key type and size per selector), and the DMARC record (policy, subdomain policy, report addresses, and whether it is inherited from the organisational domain). DKIM selectors cannot be listed from DNS: pass the selectors to check, or leave them out to try 15 common ones, and the result names every selector tried. A lookup that failed is reported as "could not be checked", never as "no record". For a spoofing-risk grade use check_spoofability instead.

domain.description: Domain to look up, e.g. example.com

selectors.description: DKIM selectors to check, up to 10, e.g. ["google", "selector1"]. Leave out to try 15 common selectors.

name: lookup_email_auth
